# Development Conventions

## JavaScript

- Use Node.js 20+.
- Prefer `const`; use `let` only when reassignment is required.
- Do not use `var`.
- Use descriptive camelCase names.
- Keep the solution proportional to the assignment.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Keep console output readable.
- Prefer strict equality (`===`) for comparisons.

## Comments

- Explain why something is necessary when a comment is useful.
- Do not add comments that simply repeat obvious code.

## Git

- Keep commits focused on one assignment.
- Use a descriptive commit message.
- Do not commit generated dependencies or secrets.
